explication: atvloadly is a web service for sideloading and refreshing apps on Apple TV. The main workflow is to discover and pair a TV, choose an IPA or tracked source, install it using an Apple ID or external signing identity, and later refresh or update it. The map also includes device discovery, source tracking, certificate management, MCP, notifications, and screenshots. Edges use the sampled source index or README as evidence; several implementations were not sampled, so their internal connections are omitted.
